product_one_liner.value: Vim connects health-plan data and tools to clinicians’ EHR workflows, helping payers, providers, and healthcare technology developers coordinate care and run point-of-care workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: Company positioning describes its platform as connecting payers, providers, EHRs, and digital health innovators.

pricing_page.notes: Public page titled CCA Pricing lists rates.

named_customers.notes: Both appear as featured case studies.

eng_blog.notes: Index includes multiple technical posts, including infrastructure and EHR integration topics, by named engineers.

public_docs.notes: Public developer portal includes platform documentation, SDK material, and API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company job board reports no current openings.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed available product, security and blog information; no public statement specifying an AI model or provider was found.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust Center names SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST CSF. HIPAA also appears there as a compliance standard, but the list here contains certifications claimed.

last_funding.notes: The May 2021 funding coverage describes a $60 million round as Series B, while funding-history reporting calls the most recent round Series C. The round value is reported as $60 million; stage is labeled Series C by the funding-history source.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent round shown is from May 2021, well before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company job board reports no current openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable newsroom's latest product-launch type announcements found were dated October 20, 2025 and January 16, 2025, both earlier than the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The team page checked in full does not identify any C-level or VP-level person as having joined during the 12-month window; no departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The accessible developer documentation and job board did not identify CRM or sales/marketing systems.
